scientific_scope: This matched Stokes comparison uses the flaperon recovery and conditional isotope screen only, not the nine recovery episodes in the broader CMEMS surface.
Source observation bandwidth, probability floor, transport support and object response are explicit source-model sensitivities, not calibrated measurements.
Surface was released at 00:19; reusing it for later impacts neglects the difference in the first minutes of drift. Nearest-source distance remains a reported approximation.
This release exposes the source surface only as an explicitly enabled conditional sensitivity; it does not change the central posterior.
Parent terminal family openap26-positive-lift-6-targets, contact case r600-shared-startup; parent source already includes the cruise, fuel and selected final-contact weights exactly once.

Spatial comparison conditions on computed impacts. Parent incoming mass with uncomputed contact likelihood: 0.22748614043962337; computed impact mass within scored support: 0.7335881891611253. These unresolved masses are not evidence against their locations.
One terminal Monte Carlo seed is used here; its four cruise source populations are already pooled with their recorded effort and normalizers. No new equal-weight pool or legacy handoff is fabricated.
Out-of-support parent mass 0.000009 is removed only by the explicit 'condition_on_native_support' sensitivity condition; it is not evidence against those particles.

No extra likelihood floor is added. Source numerical underflow is preserved and is not evidence of physical impossibility. Floors already present in source observation models remain source assumptions.
This branch is deliberately separate from the parent SATCOM/impact posterior and cannot be stacked with another family representing the same observations.

Conditional weight effective row count is 270.18; it measures concentration, not independent flight ancestry or calibrated uncertainty. Independent numerical repeats are required to assess sampling variation.
